caption: The drawing features three views of a single ring design displayed on a plain, light beige background. At the top center, there is a horizontal view of the ring's bezel, which shows five square or rectangular green gemstones set side by side, bordered on either end by yellow-gold decorative elements. Slightly below and in the center, there is a circular representation of the ring in profile, highlighting the round gold band and the row of green stones set across the top. At the bottom center, there is a side view of the ring, which reveals the green stones set in a row and supported by a structure of yellow-gold, with leaf-like golden decorations flanking the stone setting and a smooth gold shank. The name "John H. Tercuzzi" appears in small grey text in the lower left corner of the composition. The drawing uses shades of green for the gemstones and yellow-brown for the gold elements, with fine lines and light shading to indicate form and dimension.
title: Emerald Ring
